content.short: Community that guides members through investment protocols and P2E gaming systems while providing giveaways and scholarships.
content.description:
Crypto College is an NFT access community that provides data driven reviews, guides, and social/educational content of P2E games and investments across multiple blockchains. Tiered NFTs allow for members to choose their participation level for weekly/monthly giveaways, scholarship opportunities, and customized educational content.

Crypto College seeks to continually build a collaborative community that aggregates fiscal and intellectual resources and remove barriers in the crypto space that often times present themselves to the entry level-mid level investor/gamer with pooled investing, metaverse land access sharing, and scholarship programs.

With weekly livestreams, project reviews, and lively socials, Crypto College is the conduit of crypto information for everyone from the casual to advanced crypto enthusiasts.
